name: CuraSphereSourceApp
title: Current-source patient-scoped read-only app API
description: Restricted local SMART-style subset. Base R4 projections omit private source context/profile assertions. Not full SMART certification, US Core, licensed terminology or clinical approval.

security.description: Public client authorization code with S256 PKCE; exact patient/type read scopes; original live session/purpose/facility and current source policy. Registered-origin bearer CORS only. No cookie fallback, refresh/offline/system/user/write scopes or OIDC identity tokens.
